verdict.line: You lose if she lands Q into E all-in before you hit level 3 and unlock W (Path Maker); from level 3 on, every time she jumps to a wall with E (Hookshot) you punish the landing with W's charge-and-stun and win the fight.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire kit routes through her E (Hookshot), a 16/15/14/13/12s dash to a wall that knocks up on landing — without it she has no engage or disengage, just an empowered Q auto. K'Sante's W (Path Maker) is a charge-up that takes reduced damage before dashing into a knockback and stun, which is the exact counter to her landing off E: she jumps in committed, you charge through the incoming damage and stun her on arrival. The matchup is a race between her E cooldown and your W cooldown (14/13/12/11/10s) — once yours is consistently shorter, she stops being able to engage safely.

theirWindow.when: her Q and E are both up
theirWindow.what: She can land the empowered auto from Q (Precision Protocol) then jump off a wall with E for a knockup all-in. If you don't have W (Path Maker) up to answer the E landing, use E (Footwork) for the shield and disengage rather than trading auto for auto.

yourWindow.when: she jumps in with E and W is up
yourWindow.what: Charge W (Path Maker) into her landing — the charge reduces the damage you take from her follow-up autos, then the dash knocks her back and stuns her. Follow with Q (Ntofo Strikes) stacks to keep her locked as she recovers from the stun.

powerCurve.note: Her empowered Q auto outtrades your bare Q
W online punishes every E engage she makes
Your R flips her Ultimatum lock-in fights
Tank items widen the duel gap further
Her delayed Q recast burst stays relevant

start.why: The passive damage reduction on being hit by champion autos blunts her early Q-empowered poke and lets you hold the wave without losing HP.

boots.why: She's an auto-attack reliant duelist; the flat physical damage reduction on autos cuts directly into her Q, W outer-ring, and passive-shield-enabling basic attacks.

core.why: Gives you the tempo and damage to actually threaten her back once W lands, instead of just surviving her all-in.
She's a sustained-auto duelist; grievous wounds shuts down the healing she gets from the outer half of W (Tactical Sweep), and the reflect punishes her for staying in melee range.
Bonus health and the momentum speed help you stick to her after a W stun and keep chasing through the transformed R window.

situational.when: she is ahead and her Q-empowered autos are ending trades before you can charge W
her R's bonus magic damage on autos is adding up and there's a second magic threat on their team
you're winning duels and want to remove her incentive to all-in you a second time

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades are where you win this lane once W is online; Grasp rewards you for staying in melee range through her auto-attack pokes instead of trading burst-for-burst.

summoners.why: Flash lets you close the gap onto her E landing spot or dodge her E knockup if W isn't up; Teleport keeps you on the wave for plates since neither champion has reliable wave-clear pressure early.

playing.title: Bait her E, then W
playing.detail: She has to land near a wall to use E (Hookshot). Hold W (Path Maker) until she's committed to the jump, charge through the landing, and stun her on arrival.

playing.title: Track her Q cooldown
playing.detail: Precision Protocol is 9/8/7/6/5s and empowers her next auto with bonus damage and move speed. If it's up and she's approaching, expect the empowered hit before she commits further.

playing.title: Bank Q stacks near a wall
playing.detail: Ntofo Strikes grants a stack on hit; at 2 stacks you fire a shockwave that pulls enemies in. Use this to drag her off a wall before she can reach it for E.

playing.title: Play off side walls at 1-2
playing.detail: Before your W is online you have no answer to her E engage. Positioning away from walls denies her the jump-off point entirely.

playing.title: Save E for her burst, not poke
playing.detail: Footwork's shield is best held for the Q-empowered auto or the all-in burst, not spent trading pokes early.

playing.title: Use R to flip her Ultimatum
playing.detail: Her R (140/115/90/0/0s CD) anchors you to an area, but your R (All Out) knocks her through a wall and transforms your kit for the fight — engage into her lock-in rather than trying to disengage from it.

playing.title: Respect a held Q recast
playing.detail: Her Q can be recast for a delayed, much bigger hit. If she's not swinging the empowered auto immediately, she may be holding it — don't extend into range assuming it's already spent.
